title: RAG / retrieved-context security — Splunk hunt (schema 1.6.0)
schema.name: agentsec.security_event
schema_version_note: LAB-MCP-001 Q-MCP-*.spl does not filter schema.version and is 1.6.0-compatible. This hunt is schema-version agnostic in SPL.

queries.security_question: What retrieved context did this run observe, how was it classified, and did a follow-on tool request after that observation get authorized?

queries_not_created.reason: SUPPORTED by Q-RAG-CONTEXT-AUTHORITY context_* columns. A second hunt would duplicate CONTEXT-001.
SUPPORTED by context_trust / context_decision / context_reason. Q-MCP-AUTHZ already shows the OBSERVE row without RAG fields.
Hash is indexed on CONTEXT-001. ATTACK/RETEST equality is a two-run CLI comparison of context_hash, not a join hunt.
REUSED: Q-MCP-AUTHZ hop-1 row, Q-MCP-TOOL, and Q-RAG-CONTEXT-AUTHORITY followon_* columns.
REUSED: Q-MCP-AUTHZ already tables hop-1 CTRL-MCP-001 decision and reason.

detection.note: Reused unchanged. DET-RAG not created. Overlay reason and AGENT NOTE regex are REJECT as production detectors.
